product.title: Boeing Factory Tour from Seattle

description.text: Take a half-day trip from Seattle to the Boeing Everett factory for a guided assembly-plant tour and Future of Flight exhibits. Hotel pickup across the greater Seattle area includes time at the aviation gallery and gift shop.

highlights: Half-day Boeing factory tour from Seattle
Hotel pickup across greater Seattle area
Future of Flight interpretive center visit

start.description: Hotel pickup available across the greater Seattle area when confirmed after booking.

end.description: Return to the original Seattle pickup location.
